description: Test of the physical pentest devices: the pocket rogue AP (plant, clone a Wi-Fi network on a key page or a staff sign-in page, harvest the key or an account, join the staff Wi-Fi, sign in with the harvested account) and the switch drop box behind a patch panel. Nothing to solve.
test_objective: Prove the rogue AP's plant gates the harvested key and password on the server, each portal template harvests its own thing once, a refused or wrong clone harvests nothing, the harvested key joins the staff Wi-Fi and the harvested password signs in at the hot desk; and that the patch panel plants the drop box on the right network per port
